title: Hi {{name}}, welcome to Inner Circle 🌿
sub: You don't have to figure everything out at once. Take a moment for yourself.

checkin.title: How are you feeling today?
checkin.subDone: You have already checked in today — you can change it any time.
checkin.subNew: Pick whatever feels closest. Nothing is wrong.

note.thanks: Thanks for checking in with yourself.
note.question: What would help you right now?
note.tiny: A mood is a moment, not a verdict — it never defines your mental health on its own.

chat.title: Talk to your AI companion
chat.body: Type or speak — a supportive conversation, whenever you want it. No topic is too small.

minute.title: One-Minute Reset
minute.body: A single quiet minute with a breathing circle.

checkin.title: Mental Health Check-in
checkin.body: PHQ-9 and GAD-7 screening, whenever you choose.

mood.title: My Mood Journey
mood.body: Your check-ins, tiny wins and reflections.

pro.title: Contact a Professional
pro.body: Department of Psychiatry, Dayananda Sagar University.

sentiment.title: Sentiment analysis
sentiment.body: Every message you send to the companion is analysed for emotional tone — see it working on the chat page.

disclaimer.pre: Inner Circle offers screening, support and a route to professional help. It does not diagnose or prescribe, and it is not an emergency service — use
disclaimer.post: if you may be in danger.
